newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials seen opening weaker.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials seen opening weaker.

text.p: The Dow Industrials are expected to open lower Thursday, following through on yesterday's sell-off and little affected by news of the death of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping.
A published report that Goldman Sachs strategist Abby Cohen was adjusting her bullish views may have just a limited effect on trading. Her comments were faxed to clients last Friday, analysts said.
"The morning looks weak. Momentum late yesterday was downward," said Prudential Securities analyst Larry Wachtel.
